d:
Dhanteras ke pavan avsar par bihar ke navada jile ke sarrapha bajar men jabardast raunak aur grahkon ka bhari utsah dekhne ko mil raha hai. subah se hi shahar ki sona-chandi dukanon par kharidaron ki lanbi kataren lagi huee hain.
Is bar aabhushnon ki kimton men aaee giravat ne grahkon ki khushi ko doguna kar diya hai, jisse log apne bajat aur pasand ke anusar khulkar kharidari kar rahe hain. dhanteras par dhatu kharidna atyant shubh mana jata hai, aur isi paranpra ko nibhane ke lie navadavasi apne pure parivar ke sath bajar pahunch rahe hain.
